artworks.title: Kabuki Actor with a Fan
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with a forward-leaning posture, their body turned to the side and their head facing forward. The person has a focused expression and neatly combed hair styled in a traditional Japanese manner. They wear a kimono with intricate patterns: a blue outer garment with a lighter pattern and a dark inner garment with geometric designs. The person holds a folded fan in their right hand, extending it outward. The backdrop features patterned, woven elements creating a lattice effect, with stylized Japanese characters at the top. The setting evokes a traditional Japanese scene.

artworks.title: Martyre de Saint Estienne (The Martyrdom of Saint Sebastian)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ingrid Rose in memory of her husband Milton Rose
artworks.description: The image features a scene with figures and a landscape, including hills and castle-like structures in the distance. The sky contains a cloud formation with cherubs and an angel. The composition showcases intricate brushwork in an etching style, with fine lines and shading. The color palette is monochromatic in blacks, whites, and grays, highlighting the contrast and theatrical tone. Details like trees and architectural elements frame the scene.

artworks.title: Vue du Peristylium de la maison de l'Impressario
artworks.artist: Francesco Piranesi, after Giovanni Battista Piranesi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ingrid Rose in memory of her husband Milton Rose
artworks.description: The image displays an ancient ruin, seen from above with a courtyard filled with columns. The horizon is hidden by the architecture and trees. The artwork shows intricate details of the columns, trees, and figures. The color scheme is mainly sepia and brown, enhancing the old-fashioned feel. Three figures in classical attire engage in everyday actions. More columns stretch into the background, creating depth. The scene merges with the sky, adding dimension.

artworks.title: The Feast in the House of Simon
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 33 × 60.2 cm (13 × 23 11/16 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a banquet with many people gathered around a long dining table. The scene shows individuals in an ornate indoor setting with architectural features, such as columns and wall decorations. Various food items and objects are displayed on the table, while people are seen engaging in activities like serving food, talking, and attending to tasks.

artworks.title: An Antique Sacrifice
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two scenes depicting ancient architectural and ceremonial themes. The upper scene illustrates a group gathered inside a classical rotunda, intricately decorated with fluted columns, relief sculptures, and a prominent statue of a nude figure holding an object. The lower scene shows another dynamic assembly where figures are engaged in a vibrant procession or ritualistic dance, some carrying objects. The imagery invokes themes of classical antiquity, with figures draped in flowing garments and captured in active postures.

artworks.title: The Transport of the Holy House of Loreto
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a religious scene with angelic and divine figures surrounding a central crowned figure holding a child. The setting is amidst clouds with bright light illuminating the scene. Italian text is visible at the bottom. The landscape includes various figures engaged in different activities. The linework is intricate and reminiscent of historical religious illustrations.

artworks.title: René Descartes
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Lawrence Lawver
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body, positioned seated and turned slightly to his left. His face features distinct facial hair with a mustache and a small goatee. The man has shoulder-length, wavy, dark hair. He wears a coat or cloak with a high white collar and a dark garment underneath. In his left hand, he holds a hat, visible at the bottom left of the image. The background is textured, possibly indicating a printed or engraved medium with Latin text at the top and along the bottom edge, along with inscriptions likely identifying the individual and the creators of the portrait.

artworks.title: Studies of Eleven Heads
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch with several bust portraits of people. In the center, a woman faces forward with a serene expression. Surrounding her are various male figures with different expressions and hairstyles. The background is filled with more faces, creating a collage effect with intricate cross-hatching and shading, with no distinct environmental elements indicated.

artworks.title: A Moonlit Harbor
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Lawrence Lawver
artworks.description: The image shows a night scene with ships on the water. The horizon is below the middle, with ships silhouetted in the center and to the right. The brushstrokes are soft, creating a diffuse effect. The color palette is black, gray, and pale. Moonlight casts a glow on the water's surface. A structure stands in the distance. The moon is partially hidden by clouds on the left, providing the only light source.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Fallen Tree (Paysage à l'arbre cassé)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a rocky terrain with towering stone formations and dense foliage. The sky is textured and the scene is created using an etching technique with intricate linework. There are two figures in the scene, one appearing to climb or position near a rock, while the other observes. The color palette is monochromatic, using black on a white background to depict depth and dimension in the artwork.

artworks.title: Christ Carried to the Tomb
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint, printed in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of mourners gathered around a shrouded figure beneath a dramatic sky. The scene features an interplay of light and dark, possibly illustrating a sorrowful event. The central figure, draped in a cloth, is held by two individuals, while others exhibit expressions of grief. The sky above them is filled with clouds, with a shaft of light highlighting the intensity of the scene. The style is reminiscent of Rembrandt, known for his use of chiaroscuro and capturing emotive moments.

artworks.title: Boats in a Morning Fog
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and roulette on simili Japan
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with sailboats in the distance. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, emphasizing the sky. The boats are silhouetted against the water and sky. The artwork has a soft style with gentle brushstrokes. The color palette consists of muted greys and beiges, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Tall Ships in a Harbor
artworks.medium: drypoint and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows multiple ships with tall masts positioned in the center and extending to the left side of the composition. The viewpoint is slightly elevated above the water, capturing the silhouettes of the ships in profile against the horizon. The horizon is high in the narrow composition, with reflections of the ships in the water below. The painting features delicate, etching-like brushstrokes creating a textured feel. The color palette is predominantly beige and dark brown, giving a vintage and atmospheric quality. The sky merges with the water in the distance, contrasting with the detailed ships in the foreground.

artworks.title: Nouvelle Zélande, Presqu'ile de Banks (View of Collier's Point, New Zealand)
artworks.description: The image depicts a coastal scene with a curve in the shoreline viewed from above. The horizon is near the top, showing hills or low mountains with clouds. The style is detailed with thin lines, resembling etching or engraving, giving a textured look with cross-hatching. The color scheme is primarily gray, creating a classic feel. Trees and possible figures are seen on the shore, with small boats in the distance on the water. The scene conveys a calm yet active relationship between land, water, and sky.

artworks.title: Satan Defying the Powers of Heaven
artworks.medium: graphite, black chalk, and gray wash
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: From below, we look up at a nude, muscular man striding from one dark gray boulder to another against a mist-gray background in this vertical drawing. The man’s left knee, to our right, is bent as he leans onto that leg. His other leg is stretched behind him so the foot reaches into the lower left corner of the sheet. The man holds his right arm, to our left, high with his fingers outstretched, and he turns his head to look in that direction. The background is mostly washes of muted, nickel gray with a lighter, fog-gray washes in the bottom left quadrant. The man’s body is outlined lightly in graphite and chalk and shaded with pale peachy tan. The sheet has a discolored crease across the middle.

artworks.title: Decorative Motifs with Garlands (verso)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on brown paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two decorated panels or frames. The image shows two adjacent vertical panels, each adorned with lavish floral and ornamental designs. Each panel features a central circular medallion that contains a figure. The left panel depicts a seated figure holding a staff, surrounded by a circular garland of flowers, beneath an elaborate canopy of decorative chains or drapes. The right panel features a similar composition, with a seated figure and possible infant or smaller figure amidst floral embellishments, again under an ornate canopy. Below these medallions, various sketches of objects are drawn, including a helmet or ornate dish. The overall color palette consists of muted tones and sketchy outlines.

artworks.title: Saint Agnes (verso)
artworks.artist: Master of the Drapery Studies after Martin Schongauer
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: In the image, there is a detailed line drawing of a full-length figure standing on the right side. The person is upright, holding a palm branch in their right hand and a book in their left. The person has delicate facial features, an expressionless gaze, long curly hair, and wears a crown of greenery or leaves. They are dressed in long robes that cover their entire body. Two lambs rest on the ground next to them, each with intricate woolly coat detailing. The left side of the image is mostly blank, with a textured and aged appearance. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Spring--Burning Fallen Trees in a Girdled Clearing. Western Scene
artworks.artist: William James Bennett after George Harvey
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harry W. Havemeyer in memory of his father, Horace Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image depicts a ground-level view of a group of people within a natural setting. The horizon is visible in the top third of the image with bare trees reaching above it. In the center, there is a plume of smoke rising from a smoldering tree trunk. The brushstrokes are smooth and detailed, creating a soft portrayal of the scene. The color palette includes earthy tones such as browns, greens, and grays. Closest to the viewer, a large tree trunk with exposed roots is prominent. In the distance, a simple log cabin and an ox are seen amidst the wooded backdrop.

artworks.title: Summer--A  Road Accident. A glimpse thro' an opening of the Primitive Forest. Thornville, Ohio
artworks.artist: William James Bennett after George Harvey
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harry W. Havemeyer in memory of his father, Horace Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image shows a dirt road leading through a forest. The road is lined with brown leaves and earth tones, with tall trees on both sides. In the background is a town with several buildings and a church steeple. Two horses, a man, and a toppled cart are on the left side of the road. The sky is light blue. The painting is detailed, capturing the texture of the trees and foliage with a natural color palette of greens and browns.

artworks.title: Dartmouth College Church, Professor Clement Long's House, President Nathan Lord's House, Sherman Nunnery
artworks.description: The image shows a street with trees and wooden houses. The trees are bare and line both sides of the road. A church steeple can be seen in the distance on the left. The wooden houses have shuttered windows. The photo is in sepia tone, creating a vintage feel. The color palette is mostly brown, giving a historical ambiance.

artworks.title: Kamiesch: Entrée du Port (2e Vue) (Kamiesch: Port of Entry (2nd View))
artworks.artist: Jean Baptiste Henri Durand-Brager, and Pierre Lassimonne
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with water, ships anchored near the horizon, a rocky shore with a wooden structure, and sailing ships with tall masts in the distance. The scene has a sepia color tone and a vintage look.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl standing in a portrait setting. She is positioned leaning against a decorative balustrade with her arms resting on it. She has delicate facial features and is wearing a large, fashionable hat that covers most of her styled hair. She is dressed in a striped dress with puffed sleeves, a large bow at the waist, white stockings, and dark shoes. She holds a basket with flowers in her left hand. The background includes a large urn with sculptural detailing and an elegant fabric draped over the balustrade. The overall composition gives the appearance of a studio photograph with a classical setting.

artworks.title: Ami Ed. Zamacois (Eduardo Zamacois y Zabala)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Dewayne and Faith Perry
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a table with his arms resting on it, facing to the right. He has a curly beard and mustache, thick wavy hair, wears a dark jacket over a light-colored shirt. On the table are a pitcher and a shallow dish with a small round object. In the background, there is a shelf with decorative items, including a large urn or vase and various smaller objects. The style is an etching with intricate linework, creating texture and depth. The scene appears to be indoors with a softly detailed background.

artworks.title: Cleopatra
artworks.medium: mezzotint with aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a profile of a person labeled as Cleopatra, with the upper torso and head visible. The subject is in a seated position, turned slightly to the left. The person has facial features with a straight nose and full lips. They are wearing an elaborate headpiece with draped fabric and round shapes resembling pearls or beads. The clothing is not detailed. The background is blank with a textured appearance. The image seems to be an artistic representation on a plain, light-colored background with markings and the word "CLEOPATRA" inscribed below the figure.
